capabilities: Organize writing projects into nested groups and sheets in a dedicated Library sidebar
Track word counts, goals, deadline pacing, streaks, and a writing heatmap
Toggle a distraction-free Flow Mode that hides sidebars, tabs, and navigation
Compile projects to PDF, DOCX, EPUB, or Markdown with style presets
Manage per-project bibliographies and CSL citation styles
extras: Some features (Manuscript Mode, project-wide Outline, Dataview and Templater integration) are listed on a roadmap and not yet available. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and full documentation lives in a separate Getting Started guide.
intentEvidence: inspired by Ulysses but without giving up Obsidian's power and flexibility
motivation: The author wanted the focus of a dedicated writing app like Ulysses without leaving Obsidian or giving up its power and flexibility.
problem: Obsidian lacks a dedicated writing-app workflow for managing long-form projects with goals, pacing, and compiled manuscripts.

relations.evidence: inspired by Ulysses but without giving up Obsidian's power and flexibility

summary: Project-based writing toolkit that adds a dedicated workspace with groups, word count goals, deadline pacing, streaks, and export.
